mentions.name: My Sukari
mentions.description: A platform of free tools for diabetics. Its main fleshed-out feature, the Sugar Dashboard, visualizes glucose data to help users analyze it more easily. Still in development on weekends and not yet ready for public use.
mentions.problem: Most CGMs are geo-locked and don't work in Kenya, and carb-measuring apps like CalorieKing aren't available in the region, making diabetes management tools hard to access.
mentions.source_excerpt:
started working on My Sukari as a platform of free tools for diabetics.

I mostly get time to work on it on the weekends, so it's not yet ready for public use, but I've fully fleshed out one of the main features: Sugar Dashboard - A dashboard that visualises your Glucose data and helps you easier analyse it.
